definitions.explanation: The process of keeping eggs warm so that the embryos inside develop and eventually hatch. Used for both natural incubation by parent birds and artificial incubation using machines.

examples.japanese: {孵卵|ふらん}{器|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
examples.english: Warm the eggs in an incubator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{孵卵|ふらん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦およそ→およそ：02534_oyoso⟧{二十一|にじゅういち}⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧です。
examples.english: The incubation period for chickens is approximately twenty-one days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧な⟦{鳥類|ちょうるい}→鳥類：04927_chourui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{孵卵|ふらん}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧ひな⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}て→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: In conservation programs for rare birds, chicks are raised through artificial incubation and released into the wild.

notes:
Composed of {孵|ふ} (hatch) and {卵|らん} (egg). The character {孵|ふ} is specific to the hatching process and is not commonly used outside this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {孵卵|ふらん}{器|き}: incubator (for eggs)
- {孵卵|ふらん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: incubation period
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{孵卵|ふらん}: artificial incubation
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{孵卵|ふらん}: natural incubation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{孵化|ふか}→孵化：19845_fuka⟧: hatching (the moment of emerging from the egg, rather than the incubation process)
- {抱卵|ほうらん}: brooding; sitting on eggs (the act of a bird sitting on its eggs to warm them)

USAGE:
{孵卵|ふらん} emphasizes the warming and development process, while ⟦{孵化|ふか}→孵化：19845_fuka⟧ emphasizes the moment of hatching. In practice, ⟦{孵卵器|ふらんき}→孵卵器：23728_furanki⟧ (incubator) is the most commonly encountered form of this word.
